items.title: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
items.summary: Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round.
items.creator: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Nvidia reverses course and brings Jensen Huang back as CEO
items.summary: The stunning reversal was supported by senior officials in the U.S. government.
